name: Paranoia ~Kyouki no Yami~
source:
Main character gets fired for sexual harassment. While wondering around the town he stumbles upon some ruins. Inside he finds a trunk filled with money. He swears to have his revenge on the former coworkers with the found treasure. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因性骚扰被解雇。在城中游荡时，他偶然发现一些废墟，里面有一只装满钱的箱子。他发誓要用这笔意外之财向前同事复仇。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
